title: Scarab Sorcerer Ritual
description: A hooded figure wearing a crown of scarabs and a glowing eye sits before a large mound of black dung covered in golden rings and scarab beetles. The figure gestures with both hands as mathematical symbols float between them and a large beetle on the mound, surrounded by robed followers and floating scarab icons in a hazy background.
prompt: A mysterious hooded sorcerer wearing a crown made of scarab beetles with a single glowing eye, sitting in front of a large black mound of dung covered in golden rings and crawling scarab beetles, mathematical symbols floating from their gesturing hands toward a large horned beetle on the mound, surrounded by robed cultist figures holding staffs with scarab symbols, multiple glowing scarab icons floating in the hazy background, dark fantasy style, detailed illustration
